task_message:
Case V08: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 231x231x121 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case V08 is complete. Summary of the work:

- **Target**: vascular soft-tissue tumor — a large, lobulated, markedly T2-hyperintense heterogeneous mass (with hypointense septa/flow voids) in the limb/pelvic soft tissues.
- **Method**: located the lesion on axial/coronal/sagittal sheets, seeded the model with positive points inside the bright heterogeneous core (v1), then applied one model refinement (v2).
- **Verification**: checked the mask in all three planes at multiple levels and at both ends (axial 1/5/44/48/58/63, coronal 92/112/140, sagittal 111/145); ran the final review with five slices per plane (extent axial 0–65, coronal 83–153, sagittal 82–144), confirmed lesion tissue is fully contained with no residue just past the ends, and rejected all four automatic candidates (they outlined subcutaneous fat/body wall, not tumor).
- **Result**: final mask v2, volume 86.9 mL, single dominant component (99.9%), saved with medium confidence (the superior tapering tip and irregular fascial margins are the remaining uncertainties).
